The prompt says template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). So we should use reaction_id as template_id.

The second entry reaction_id 170616 has mapped_rxn: 'CC1=CC=C([NH2:1])C=C1.CCN(CC)CC.[O:3]=[S:2](=[O:4])(Cl)[C:5]1=[CH:6][CH:7]=[CH:8][CH:9]=[CH:10]1.C1CCOC1>>[NH2:1][S:2](=[O:3])(=[O:4])[C:5]1=[CH:6][CH:7]=[CH:8][CH:9]=[CH:10]1'

Third entry reaction_id 295881 similar.

Probably the simplest is the fourth entry reaction_id 30951: mapped_rxn: '[NH2:7]C1=C(Cl)C(Cl)=CC=C1.C1=CC=NC=C1.O.[CH3:1][C:2]1=[CH:3][CH:4]=[C:5]([S:6](=[O:8])(=[O:9])Cl)[CH:10]=[CH:11]1>>[CH3:1][C:2]1=[CH:3][CH:4]=[C:5]([S:6]([NH2:7])(=[O:8])=[O:9])[CH:10]=[CH:11]1'

That's also complex.

But we just need any template that matches sulfonamide formation. The first entry seems to involve sulfonyl chloride reacting with an amine to give sulfonamide plus other fragments (maybe a benzoyl group). However the product is sulfonamide attached to aromatic ring.

Probably acceptable to return first entry's mapped_rxn and template_id 41227.

Thus final answer JSON with mapped_rxn and template_id 41227.
